description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It is used to manage large or time-consuming tasks without blocking the UI, such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard. The code includes functions for creating a controller to handle batching, progress reporting, and cancellation, as well as a React hook that wraps this controller to manage UI state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with support for progress callbacks, cancellation, and adaptive batching based on total items.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing, wrapping the createProgressiveExpandController to provide progress, running state, and control functions.
